did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. The date the courier rates were last checked was set back to 1 July 2026, so that more than three months had passed (the three months could not be waited for). The owner opened the Couriers screen and pressed the confirm button.

checks.text: The Couriers screen showed a red notice: "Are the courier rates still correct? Nobody has checked for three months." with the button "Yes, they are still correct"
After pressing it the screen said "Thank you. We will ask again in three months." and "Rates last checked 22 Oct 2026", and the notice went away

notes: Done by hand in the live browser. The three months were not waited for: the last-checked date was moved back with a command, and everything after that was done on the screen. The same reminder is also meant to show on the owner's home screen; that was not looked at.

shots.caption: The three-month reminder on the Couriers screen
After confirming: thanked, date updated, notice gone
